message.content: No, based on the messages provided, there is no indication that Li Hua thanked Jennifer Moore for the new training schedule before requesting a change in his training schedule for Thursday. The first message regarding the training schedule adjustment appears in Source 2, which states that Li Hua expresses excitement about the new training plan and asks Jennifer if he can adjust the schedule to fit his work commitments. This request precedes any mention of a previous training schedule or appreciation for it.
